packet_dag.terminal_condition: The public /one-time page locally renders the requested black/white/yellow Mishnayos signup funnel without checkout, payment, send, access, or private Operations leakage.

title: OneTimeOneTime Public Landing Signup Funnel

reasons: The operator requested a public UI/copy replacement for the OneTimeOneTime Mishnayos landing page.
The scope is one public marketing route with config/action/test echoes, not a multi-surface super-ramble.
The prompt explicitly requires placeholder media and forbids signup/payment logic changes.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Final live signup or checkout route approval
Production release gate and live smoke
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After local verification, publish/deploy/live-smoke from a clean release branch or replace placeholder media in a separate asset packet.

operator_intent_summary: Turn the public OneTimeOneTime Mishnayos page into a focused signup funnel for the upcoming class using the original black/white/yellow OneTimeOneTime site feel.
raw_quotes: black/dark navy background, white text, bright yellow accents
Use placeholders for images/videos for now
Replace the current ugly/basic landing page

decisions_captured.decision: Final hero media, final dark-header logo, and live signup/checkout URL are not approved in this packet.
Production deploy/live smoke requires a clean release gate.

out_of_scope: No payment, checkout, Stripe, Green Invoice, charge, or access-grant behavior changes.
No email, WhatsApp, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, DNS, Railway, GHL, LeadConnector, or external-provider writes.
No private parent, student, provider, Operations, or test-access content on the public page.

known_blockers: Final hero media asset and live signup route are not approved.
Production deploy/live smoke is blocked until scoped publish/release gate is available.
observed_visual_defects: The existing page still used the older Learn Mishnayos Live/Vimeo promo structure instead of the requested focused signup-funnel sections.
The old secondary CTA pointed to the public Vimeo promo instead of the requested See How It Works flow.

expanded_phrases.ugly: Replace the older generic public offer with the exact requested funnel sections, copy, and visual hierarchy.
expanded_phrases.clean: Use one consistent dark/yellow visual language, readable spacing, stable responsive grid behavior, and no private/internal text.
expanded_phrases.polished: Make the hero dominant, CTAs high contrast, cards aligned, mobile header non-overlapping, and text readable at desktop/tablet/mobile sizes.
expanded_phrases.focused signup funnel: Route public actions to #start-free and the existing first-party interest form until a live checkout/signup URL is approved.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The signup flow remains first-party BNA/One Time interest intake only. No GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM, checkout, or send runtime is added.

requirements.statement: Implement the requested OneTimeOneTime public Mishnayos signup funnel at /one-time with placeholder media and safe CTAs.
requirements.expected_result: The route shows the announcement bar, dark sticky header, dominant hero, yellow ticker, logo strip, program cards, who-it-is-for, feature grid, outcome, FAQ, and final Start Free form without changing payment or member-auth logic.
acceptance_criteria: The page uses black/white/yellow OneTimeOneTime styling with CSS variables and serif display headlines.
All public CTA links use #start-free until live signup is approved.
The existing interest form posts only to /api/one-time/interest after consent.
The page keeps /rabbi-member as the canonical member login entry.
The page includes TODO comments for final hero media and dark-header logo replacement.
Mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts do not horizontally overflow.

criteria: Raw intake and requirement register exist.
One Time brand memory/config confirms black/yellow direction.
Original-site preview asset was inspected as the design reference.
The implementation is one public route and can avoid backend/payment/auth changes.
External media/signup decisions are recorded as blockers rather than guessed.
